rows.grounds: tāra plus saṃpuṭita; enclosed by the tāra syllable
duṣṭa plus mantra compound; evil mantra
root siddh; present active third singular

items.question: Can an evil mantra succeed when it is enclosed by tāra?
items.inference: Enclosure by tāra is presented as sufficient for even an evil mantra to succeed.
uncertainties: exact scope of tāra enclosure in ritual context
whether atha marks sequence or emphasis
items.plain_english: Enclosed by tāra, or then, even an evil mantra succeeds.
